messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Subsea7
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Tonks,

Following my earlier introduction to Subsea7, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on the company's global offshore portfolio, leadership transition and country-facing execution priorities.

The paper addresses merger-era stakeholder continuity, national energy and local-content alignment, project commitment governance and ESG evidence across major offshore markets. My operating background across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and regulated project coordination is directly relevant to these interfaces.

My executive CV is included in the final three pages. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding international leadership needs across government relations, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, sustainability or country-facing execution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Subsea7
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Subsea7 is moving through a consequential period of leadership transition, merger preparation and continued large-scale offshore execution. Recent awards span major energy markets including Türkiye and Brazil, where project delivery intersects with national energy security, local-content expectations, regulatory approvals, environmental commitments and long-term client relationships. These external dependencies become more important as portfolio scale and organisational change increase. My director-level experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and strategic stakeholder coordination would support Subsea7 by strengthening country-facing governance, preserving stakeholder continuity and linking external commitments to accountable project execution across priority markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: Subsea7 announced in March 2026 that Stuart Fitzgerald would become Chief Executive Officer from July 1, during the broader strategic transition associated with the planned combination with Saipem. At the same time, the company continues to secure significant offshore work. In September 2026, Subsea7 announced a contract extension for the Sakarya gas field development offshore Türkiye, an important national energy project. In April 2026, the company announced a major contract for Sepia 2 offshore Brazil, with strong local-content and fabrication requirements supporting the country's pre-salt development. These projects demonstrate the scale of country, client, regulatory, supply-chain and community interfaces surrounding offshore execution. A consistent external governance model can strengthen continuity, local-value delivery and executive visibility across such complex markets.

opportunities.title: Merger-era stakeholder continuity
opportunities.rationale: Leadership and organisational change can create uncertainty across clients, governments, regulators, suppliers and employees, especially while major projects remain in execution. Structured continuity planning helps preserve key relationships, maintain confidence and ensure commitments do not become fragmented across changing reporting lines.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish stakeholder continuity maps and commitment registers for priority markets, identifying relationship owners, unresolved issues, regulatory dependencies and executive escalation points so external confidence remains stable through organisational transition and integration planning.

opportunities.title: National energy and local-content alignment
opportunities.rationale: Projects such as Sakarya and Sepia 2 carry strategic national importance and significant expectations around local participation, supply chains, fabrication and workforce development. Strong alignment with government and client priorities helps protect delivery while strengthening Subsea7's long-term position in key markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would connect local-content plans, government engagement and project ownership through measurable commitments, named owners and executive reporting, drawing on direct experience coordinating public institutions, contractors, communities and internal functions around local participation and strategic project obligations.

opportunities.title: Project commitment governance
opportunities.rationale: Large offshore projects generate obligations across permits, environmental conditions, communities, suppliers, workforce and clients. When these commitments are dispersed across functions, emerging issues can remain unresolved until they affect schedule or relationships. A consolidated view strengthens accountability and timely intervention.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would implement a cross-functional issue and commitment dashboard covering regulatory, social, environmental and institutional matters, with deadlines, evidence requirements and escalation thresholds tied to project milestones and reviewed regularly by project and regional leadership.

opportunities.title: ESG evidence for offshore delivery
opportunities.rationale: Offshore energy projects face close scrutiny around emissions, environmental performance, local economic contribution and transition positioning. Credible external communication requires clear linkage between public statements and operating evidence, particularly across markets with different regulatory and stakeholder expectations.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen evidence ownership and traceability for material ESG and local-value commitments, connecting operational data, environmental controls and stakeholder reporting so government, client and community engagement is supported by consistent and review-ready information.

days_0_30: Map priority markets, clients, governments, regulators and external commitments.
Review continuity risks created by leadership and organisational transition.
Identify country issues with direct schedule, local-content or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align project, government, sustainability, commercial and local-content engagement plans.
Create a single commitment and issue register with named owners and deadlines.
Define executive indicators for stakeholder continuity and country risk.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on priority government, regulatory and client dependencies.
Embed monthly cross-functional review of country risks and external commitments.
Strengthen evidence controls around ESG and local-value delivery.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority offshore markets and projects.
Measure issue closure, stakeholder response times and commitment performance.
Codify a repeatable country-facing stakeholder playbook for the combined growth platform.

potential_impact: Greater stakeholder continuity through leadership and organisational transition.
Stronger local-content and government alignment on strategic offshore projects.
Earlier visibility and resolution of regulatory, community and institutional risks.
More consistent evidence behind ESG and local-value commitments across markets.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in a regulated resource environment.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities and contractors around permits and strategic project commitments.
Experience coordinating external obligations across operations, legal, finance, procurement, environment, HR and executive teams.
Practical work on environmental-management systems, carbon-data traceability, renewable-energy positioning and local participation.
